name: internos-monorepo
description: InternOS - Multi-tenant Smart Internship Management and Monitoring System

scripts.build: npm --workspace=@internos/types run build && npm --workspace=@internos/shared run build && npm --workspace=@internos/api run build && npm --workspace=@internos/web run build
scripts.build:api: npm --workspace=@internos/types run build && npm --workspace=@internos/shared run build && npm --workspace=@internos/api run build
scripts.build:web: npm --workspace=@internos/types run build && npm --workspace=@internos/shared run build && npm --workspace=@internos/web run build
scripts.start:prod: npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:migrate && npm run start
